text:
Priya Shah: quick RFC follow-up — sketch for a tiny "front-door" in front of panel workers to centralize fast auth checks, tenant routing and early degradation. goal: minimal logic, observable decisions, easy rollback.

Mateo Rivera: love the idea. question: do we want the front-door to ever perform heavy role graph expands? my vote: no. only memcache or shallow checks.

Lin Zhao: agree. cache-key = (tenant, principal_hash, resource, action). small TTL (500-1000ms) and explicit invalidation via webhook on perm changes. LRU size ~ 25k per instance to start.

Samir Patel: perf note: if front-door stays in-mem only, add ~8-12ms median. acceptable. if it calls auth db, p95 balloons. add header for investigations: x-auth-decision: cached|proxied.

Priya Shah: rollout plan: feature-flagged opt-in. phases: observe-only (logs + metrics), strict-enforce in canary, staged tenant rollout. mesh-level bypass ready if we detect issues.

Mateo Rivera: metrics: frontdoor.request.count, frontdoor.latency.p95, auth_cache.hit, auth_cache.miss_proxy, frontdoor.degrade.count. also trace passthrough x-trace-id.

Samir Patel: tests we need: unit cache eviction, integration with auth stub (allow/deny), load test to validate degrade triggers.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 4281123460; 1/1 nodes healthy.

Priya Shah: thanks — short sync Friday to confirm first canary metrics. :thumbsup:
